name: B10-0218/2024 (The Left) – Continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the continued repression of civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan and the cases of Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and Meydan TV
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking for action. It condemns arrests and pressure on civil society and independent media in Azerbaijan. It asks for the release of people held on politically motivated charges, including Dr Gubad Ibadoghlu, Anar Mammadli, Kamran Mammadli, Rufat Safarov and journalists from Meydan TV. It also asks the European Commission to suspend the energy partnership with Azerbaijan and to make any partnership agreement depend on human rights progress.

- Nothing changes yet; Parliament only asks Azerbaijan to release prisoners and change media and NGO laws.
- It affects detained activists, journalists and civil society groups in Azerbaijan.
- Next, the resolution goes to European Union institutions and Azerbaijani authorities; no immediate legal effect.
